name: RetroForge starter picks
description: A small hand-picked list. Every entry links to the hack's official page; RetroForge does not host or download these patches.

hacks.title: Metroid: Rogue Dawn
hacks.summary: A fan-made prequel to the original Metroid with a new story, new areas and reworked graphics, built on the NES game.

hacks.title: Super Mario Bros. 3Mix
hacks.summary: A large Super Mario Bros. 3 remix with all-new levels, extra power-ups, collectable star coins and new bosses.

hacks.title: Giant Mario Bros.
hacks.summary: Super Mario Bros. with a much bigger Mario. The download includes a version that keeps the original levels, which some add-on hacks build on.

hacks.title: Super Metroid: Redesign
hacks.summary: A complete overhaul of Super Metroid with a redesigned world and a much tougher challenge, aimed at players who know the original well.

hacks.title: Zelda3 Parallel Remodel
hacks.baseGame: The Legend of Zelda: A Link to the Past
hacks.summary: A reworked, more approachable version of the famous Parallel Worlds hack, with less backtracking and fewer obscure tricks required.

hacks.title: Super Mario 64: Star Road
hacks.summary: A full new adventure built on Super Mario 64, with 130 new stars across new worlds. Find the patch and the exact ROM it needs on the hack's page.

hacks.title: Super Mario 64: Last Impact
hacks.summary: A large Super Mario 64 hack with new levels, new moves and custom music. Find the patch and the exact ROM it needs on the hack's page.

hacks.title: The Legend of Zelda: Ocarina of Time Redux
hacks.baseGame: The Legend of Zelda: Ocarina of Time
hacks.summary: Quality-of-life fixes for Ocarina of Time: faster text, better menus and restored content, staying close to the original. Find the patch and the exact ROM it needs on the hack's page.

hacks.title: Link's Awakening DX Redux
hacks.baseGame: The Legend of Zelda: Link's Awakening DX
hacks.summary: Improves Link's Awakening DX with a better script, fewer interruptions and graphical fixes. Find the patch and the exact ROM it needs on the hack's page.

hacks.title: Mother 3 (English translation)
hacks.summary: The well-known fan translation that makes the Japan-only Mother 3 playable in English. Find the patch and the exact ROM it needs on the hack's page.

hacks.title: The Legend of Zelda: Parallel Worlds
hacks.baseGame: The Legend of Zelda: A Link to the Past
hacks.summary: A difficult new quest built on A Link to the Past, with a new world and dungeons. Find the patch and the exact ROM it needs on the hack's page.

hacks.title: A Link to the Past Redux
hacks.baseGame: The Legend of Zelda: A Link to the Past
hacks.summary: A Link to the Past with an improved script, restored content and quality-of-life fixes, close to the original.

hacks.title: The Legend of Zelda Redux
hacks.summary: The first Zelda with a full-screen map, better text, an improved menu and other modern touches.

hacks.title: Zelda II Redux
hacks.baseGame: Zelda II: The Adventure of Link
hacks.summary: Zelda II with a better script, graphics touches and gameplay fixes, staying faithful to the original.

hacks.title: MaternalBound Redux
hacks.summary: Mother 1 (EarthBound Beginnings) rebuilt in EarthBound's engine, with new controls and MSU-1 support.

hacks.title: Super Metroid Redux
hacks.summary: Super Metroid with quality-of-life changes and bug fixes, keeping the original game's feel.

hacks.title: Metroid II Redux
hacks.summary: Metroid II with quality-of-life improvements from the Redux series.

hacks.title: Pokémon Polished Crystal
hacks.summary: An upgrade to Pokémon Crystal: up-to-date features, new areas and Pokémon, and many quality-of-life changes.

hacks.title: Metroid: Zero Mission Redux
hacks.summary: Zero Mission with quality-of-life changes and fixes.

hacks.title: Metroid Fusion Redux
hacks.summary: Metroid Fusion with quality-of-life features and some map changes.

hacks.title: Sonic 3 Complete
hacks.summary: Sonic 3 & Knuckles with restored Sonic 3 music and layouts, fixes, and lots of options to tune the game.
